Lapho bevuka, ifu labehlisela ogwini olunesihlabathi esibomvana. Amagagasi ayezwakala njengokubhodla okukhulu. UMichi wacwilisa izidladla zakhe emanzini wahleka.
ULuna wathola igobolondo elalicula izingoma zakudala. Enye yayithi: "Usuku ngalunye ozinakekela ngalo luyisinyathelo esiya enyangeni." UMichi wayifunda ngekhanda.

Phakathi nehlathi kwakukhona i-maze. UMichi walahleka, kodwa wabheka isithombe sakho, wazola futhi wathola indlela yokuphuma.

ULuna kwakufanele abuyele emndenini wakhe. Bagonana kakhulu. "Abangane beqiniso bahlala bephinde bahlangane," esho. UMichi wamnika inkanyezi yakhe.

Inyanga yamamukela ngokumamatheka okukhulu. "Ufike lapha ngoba awuzange uyeke ukunakekela umuntu wakho," isho. Yamnika okuncane kokukhanya kwayo.
UMichi wafika ekhaya ngesikhathi esifanele ukuze akubone. Ebhodla, wakunika ukukhanya kwenyanga. Kusukela lapho, noma nini lapho uzinakekela, lokho kukhanya kungaphakathi kwakho. Ukuphela 🌙
